models.name: 114H
models.nameNote: The engine identification table on PDF p2 prints the tractor model as '114'; the cover and every page header print 114H. No '114' alias (114 is a separate model in 8-2992).

engines.appliesNote: all serials in this book (ID table: tractor model 114 = engine C33753); twin cylinder per the engine pages (cylinder heads No. 1 and No. 2). Engine parts are listed under Ingersoll C numbers, not BR numbers.

editions.serialAsPrinted: No range on the cover or ID page and no serial or P.I.N. break in any table (confirmed by eye on all 24 table pages).

validation.method: Scan (no text layer): every table page read by eye, 2 table pages per image at 0.66x (12 images) plus one sheet of full-resolution zoom strips; tesseract only as a draft. Numerical index OCR'd column by column, diffed against the transcription in sort order, and every difference checked by eye on full-resolution index images (4 images).
validation.refContinuity: All sections continuous except: hood ref 23, electrical system ref 14 and electrical hardware ref 13 are not printed (index agrees). Carburetor REF column printed one row low: stored as 1-48 to match the index and the gasket-kit note, printed number kept in each row's flags. Repeated refs kept as printed (pistons 12 x4, ring sets 13 x4, valve covers 22 x2, push rods 26 x2, choke/throttle control 1 x2, foot rests 16 x2, transaxle washers 26 x3, electrical hardware 10 x2, hood decals 1 x2). 10 unnumbered rows kept (2 carburetor kits, starter, hydrostatic transmission, seal kit, oil reservoir, transaxle assembly, input assembly, C28962 wire clip, headlight assembly).
validation.quantities: Every row has a qty; 13 rows are UAR. No REQ'D column is out of register. Engine block ref 22 C34369 (R.H. valve cover) prints qty 2 (kept, flagged).
validation.numericalIndex: 630 index entries (printed pages 52-55) against 645 indexable rows (NSS rows and the paint and oil page are not indexed). 618 agree exactly as printed, and 620 after the two user-confirmed corrections (7/23 C34367 and 17/18 C34379, 2026-11-11). 8 rows where the index gives a different part number or ref for the same position (7/10, 11/36, 23/32, 25/4, 33/18, 35/9, 37/23, 39/5): table kept, each flagged. 17 table rows are not indexed (ignition 10-12, oil filter 15-16, PTO 46, brake 34, electrical 13 starter, C34369, gasket sets 2-8 and 10). 2 index entries have no table row (C34229 at 7/38, C34196 at 7/22). The index prints 13- 624 / 13- 628 as 013-. The pattern suggests the index was typed from an earlier draft of the tables.
validation.partNoForms: Ingersoll C numbers closed up (C34371); Briggs BR numbers stored bare (221798, 221535); hardware codes 'NNN-NNNN' (113-103, 138-2071, 321-6659, 353-454); 13-624 and 13-628 kept as printed (flagged). 49 NSS rows stored as NSS with source null. Starred lift-system rows stored without the asterisk (kept in partNoAsPrinted).
validation.userDecisions: 2026-11-11: (1) carburetor refs stay 1-48; (2) page 7 ref 23 and page 17 ref 18 are misprints, partNo corrected to C34367 and C34379 (printed numbers kept in partNoAsPrinted); (3) lift-system starred rows stay optional parts tied to the snowblower and 44" mower.
